name: Early Career AI Practitioner
description: Awarded for completing and passing the Early Career AI track: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, MLOps, hallucination management, responsible AI, prompt evaluation, cost and latency budgets, and shipping a first AI feature.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 8 lessons and their interactive labs, including a written feature-scoping task assessed against a rubric, then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
